task: TASK_869 (D31 (a3)) — re-base-wave semantics: UTC window boundaries + masked daily teacher floor. Baseline re-promote attribution.
why: Two measurement-semantics defects landed in the SAME re-base wave as TASK_868, so the minute panel re-bases once, not three times. Scope (1): _to_epoch resolved --start/--end in LOCAL time, so a benchmark window's extent depended on which machine ran it (measured pre-fix: a 308-row-class CEST offset on the OOS window; the 1734-vs-1735 / 2-vs-3 / 90-vs-91 count-by-one disagreements between parties). Scope (2): the daily-framed teacher floor walked UNMASKED (same defect class as D30 rider (a) on the minute floor). Every moved numeric below is attributed to scope (1) or scope (2) explicitly. Scope (2) moved NO recorded numeric: it is measured INERT on every panel the daily loader can emit (see scope_2_measurement) and ships as defence-in-depth, the 865 precedent.
